description: Subsecretaría de Planeamiento, Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires publishes the official building lines on each parcel of the City of Buenos Aires, published as several line layers, including the internal basement line and the internal front line. Coverage: the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina; a regulatory layer marked "eventual" in update frequency and last modified on 2025-04-03. Format and access: CSV, GEOJSON, XLSX, ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-2.5-AR; cost: free. Caveats: the layer describes where building is permitted, not existing buildings; the other line layers and the attribute schema were not read beyond the resource names. Simulation uses: maximum buildable-envelope inputs for densification and housing-capacity scenarios, and setback rules in urban form generators. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
